criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame is a real render in one staged last-light world. Strong on 5, 8 and 2. On 7 the lamp is still a flat disc with flat rotors. On 9 and 4 kit mannequins stand full length beside an oversized trap and on flat loam. On 1 there is banding and a grey-brown middle band. Frame 3's towers tangle through the back rows. Frame 6 sits in the grey middle.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One last-light seam keyed from the same side, barbed wire 1, 4, 8, 9, a disciplined bluebonnet accent, a legible scale ladder. Frame 6 breaks the value arc between 5 and 7.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces and the round 2 hard fail is gone. Slide 5's 'being built' carries a tense c21's 'partnering to build' does not, and the drone figures rest on KRGV alone. Slide 7 and the caption scope no case to the animals observed.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What happened, who decides and what to do, with the number. The 12 restricted counties are unlabelled rims and 'shows signs' is never described.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, 2 pays at once, 8 turns and 9 lands. Frame 6 is the movable frame.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: On register and specific, honest about limits. Slide 2's zone sentence reads like a legend key.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh against the last three; the counted-units device and the chassis structure recur.

one_sentence_fix: Label the 12 movement-restriction counties by name on slide 2's rims so a Texan can see whether their county is under restriction.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Flat unlit lamp disc and flat rotor ellipses, named by all three judges in round 2.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: An emissive lens in a housing with bloom and a cool cone on the nearest cattle, motion-blurred blades.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A full-length kit rancher and a toy Hereford on flat mid-brown loam.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Reframe over the rancher's shoulder at the latch and let the loam beyond fall to black.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A centred kit mannequin beside an oversized trap.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: The trap at true size in the near foreground as the lit focal, the worker a backlit silhouette.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Sky banding and a grey-brown middle band with a thin windmill.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Dither the sky and move the camera closer so the wheel and tank own the right half.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Front towers tangle through the back-row wheels.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Raise the eye, double the row spacing and reduce back rows to wheel silhouettes.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Grey-middle stone with bedding lines across the cut floors.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Darken the stone outside a narrow band and mask the bedding inside the cuts.
